dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle asymmetrical bulge on the left lateral margin; right margin exhibits a continuous inward curve toward the posterior.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median slate-grey tone with visible low-frequency variations; categorized as dark-grey.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse dark-pixel clusters distributed primarily across the mid-dorsal and left-lateral regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary grey baseline and darker pigmented mottling.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple linear, low-to-medium contrast marks distributed across the dorsal surface, including one prominent longitudinal mark on the lower half.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: High-contrast circular aperture at the anterior end; no significant topological deformations or trauma-induced shadows visible on the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear scarring pattern consistent with rake marks across the mid-dorsal plane and a single prominent longitudinal scar extending toward the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Clearly defined circular blowhole aperture with distinct high-contrast perimeter.
